name: a suppressed debug line is recorded anyway
why: A debug line while debug logging is off must cost nothing: not even a buffer entry.

edits.replace: if (!isDebugEnabled() && level === 'debug') { _logRecord(level, cat, msg, data); return; }

grep: a debug line is recorded only while debug logging is on

name: extra data is kept as the live value
why: The buffer must never hold a page element or a row map alive, and a line must not change after it was logged.
grep: extra data is kept as a short text

name: the buffer is never trimmed
why: A buffer that grows for ever is a leak on a long session.
grep: past the cap the oldest lines go

name: the copy hides that lines were dropped
why: A report that looks complete when its start is gone misleads whoever reads it.
grep: past the cap the oldest lines go

name: error() loses its channel again
why: error() passed 'error' as the icon, so every error would land in one channel.

edits.find: error(icon, msg, data) { this.log('error', 'error', msg, data, icon); }
edits.replace: error(icon, msg, data) { this.log('error', 'error', msg, data); }

grep: keeps its channel in the log

name: Escape closes the window with the filter still filled
why: Escape empties a filled filter first, as every other filter box of the script.
grep: the text filter narrows; Esc empties it first

name: Clear does not ask
why: Every destructive action asks first, inside the same panel.
grep: Clear asks first inside the window

name: the Markdown fence is always three backticks
why: A line quoting a fenced block would end the fence early and break the pasted report.
grep: Copy as Markdown copies a <details> block

name: a line is put in as HTML
why: A line can quote anything a page sent; it must stay text.
grep: line text is never markup

name: the chips row shows with nothing to choose
why: The chips appear only when there is a choice, as in the approved mockup.
grep: chips appear only when there is a choice

name: an open window stops receiving lines
why: The window must follow the page as it works.

edits.find: queue: (e, trimmed) => { if (trimmed) needRedraw = true; else pending.push(e); schedule(); },

name: the configured host is ignored
why: Under Event Horizon document.body is its body, which V removes: the window must go where the consumer says.
grep: the window goes into the configured host

name: no Tampermonkey menu entry
why: The menu entry is how every consumer, and the library-only browser check, reaches the window.
grep: the Tampermonkey menu entry toggles the window

name: Record detail changes nothing
why: The switch must turn detail lines on for this page, without touching the consumer's own flag.

name: onCounts is called for every warning
why: A burst of warnings must report once, or a consumer repaints its menu row per line.

name: no full screen on a phone
why: Under 600 px a floating window would cover part of the page and hide its own controls.
